card.name: Edition number in book citations
card.fires_on: The word edition (or ed, or e) right after an ordinal like Second, 6th or 4 in a book citation or reference line.

modes.label: Edition after ordinal
modes.description: The word Edition or ed after a number word like Third or 6th in a reference.
modes.example: Bayesian Methods for Data Analysis, Third<< Edition>>. Boca Raton, FL: Chapman

modes.label: Short e after number
modes.description: The letter e standing for edition right after a numeral in a textbook or book title.

card.plain: It spots the word edition in a book citation, like 'Third Edition' or '6th ed.'
